# Simplicity Investing

> Simplicity Investing India Private Limited is a Pune-based, AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-87401), operating since 2011. It helps individuals, families, NRIs and businesses with goal-based investing.

## Services
- Retirement planning and systematic withdrawal plans (SWP)
- Wealth creation through SIPs and step-up SIPs in mutual funds
- Tax-saving investments (ELSS) and capital-gains planning
- Risk management: term and health insurance sizing, emergency funds
- International investing, including GIFT City (IFSC) routes and LRS guidance
- Estate and legacy: nominations and consolidated records
- Corporate treasury: liquid and short-duration fund allocation
- Specialized Investment Funds (SIFs) for investors with ₹10 lakh or more

## Key facts
- Registration: AMFI ARN-87401 (mutual fund distributor)
- CIN: U74140PN2011PTC139962
- Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India; serves clients across India and NRIs
- Values: personalised, objective, transparent, simple
